I replied to Tobias in the #central-random thread: the ticket is **PD-4821**, the Marrow Agrisupply ticket with the Eastbank receiving-door import attached.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 2026-06-09, and Tobias is a member of that channel. In the reply, I also mentioned the door-label mismatch Hollis raised at the time: the import file uses E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02.
